title: DiscoveryRSI: Recursively Learning to Discover Valuable Hypotheses

previous_summary.summary_zh: DiscoveryRSI 改进从研究过程学习有价值假设的方式，通过多智能体演化搜索构建假设树、把研究方案编译为可执行 Harbor 任务并递归学习，其 DiscoveryRSI-27B 的假设与模型截止后发表研究的对应率达到 6.3%，高于 GPT-6 Luna 的 2.5% 和 Claude Opus 5 的 2.3%。
previous_summary.summary_en: DiscoveryRSI improves learning valuable hypotheses from the research process via multi-agent evolutionary search: building a hypothesis tree, compiling research plans into executable Harbor tasks, and recursive learning. DiscoveryRSI-27B's hypotheses match post-cutoff published research at 6.3%, above GPT-6 Luna's 2.5% and Claude Opus 5's 2.3%.

prior_review.note: 训练出 DiscoveryRSI-27B，主对象是科研假设与模型；harness replay 只是机制之一

evidence.quote: Across the two pooled DiscoveryRSI production runs, 74 of 1,176 hypothesis versions meet this criterion, giving an inspiration rate of 6.3%. The corresponding rates are 5.4% for DeepSeek (14/257), 2.8% for GLM (1/36), 2.5% for GPT (59/2,341), and 2.3% for Claude (3/131). DiscoveryRSI reaches 16.9% in therapeutic targets, 7.4% in population multi-omics, 6.8% in disease mechanisms, and 2.3% in clinical and population health ( Figure 9 ).

DiscoveryRSI-27B pools two production runs. The overall numerator and denominator are 74/1,176; domain counts are shown below. The comparison groups are DeepSeek (14/257), GLM (1/36), GPT (59/2,341), and Claude (3/131). Qwen original remains in the underlying audit but is omitted from the main presentation figure.

Candidate retrieval required the best reference card to share at least three non-stopword terms with the hypothesis. This lexical gate determines retrieval eligibility, not semantic relevance. GPT-6 Luna supplied the semantic judgments, with 145 successful judgments from 149 sampled records. Four records lacked successful judgments. Exact duplicate hypothesis–reference inputs shared a judgment, which was propagated to 903 registered hypothesis versions. The resulting labels are correlated automated assessments rather than independent expert reviews.
evidence.supports_zh: Luna是语义判分器，不是这处声明的比较组

evidence.quote: References were filtered by each group’s recorded operational cutoff. Exact-day boundaries were retained for GPT serving identifiers. Month-level boundaries were used for Qwen (April 2025, a provisional family proxy), Claude Opus 5 (May 2026), DeepSeek V4.1 (September 2026, a release-month proxy), and GLM-5.3 (August 2026, a release-month proxy). These boundaries make the comparison reproducible; they do not identify internal model knowledge cutoffs.
